headline: A {{multiplayer mod}} for Metal Gear Solid V, for up to {{16 players}}
summary: Joint Operations brings the game's online functionality into the single-player world. Up to 16 players share the open world, its missions and Mother Base.
The host takes {{Venom Snake's place}}. Everyone else joins as a soldier from the host's Mother Base roster, and players join and leave with in-game transitions instead of popping in and out.
Built in the open by Hound Protocol. Free, open to contributors, and it never includes or distributes game files.

host.title: The host stands in for Venom Snake
host.text: The host is not a separate character. They occupy {{Venom Snake's position}} in the game, so every place the story puts Snake belongs to the host.
places: Helicopter seat on insertion and extraction
Mother Base command and staff management

flow: The host starts a mission or free roam from Venom Snake's position.
Other players pick a soldier from the host's Mother Base roster and arrive in the field.
Everyone plays in one world. The host's game decides AI, missions and world state.
Players leave with an in-game exit, and the session carries on.
facts: Soldiers from the Mother Base roster
Steam relay, with direct IP as fallback
Your own copy of MGSV on Steam
principles: Research is done openly and written in our own words.
No game files, cracks or third-party mod code are ever distributed.
Nothing touches Konami online services or anti-cheat.
Anyone can contribute through the contract board.
